TeamTask.title: TeamTask
TeamTask.description: A hierarchical task node in the team dependency tree with roll-up progress, Gmail assignment, and blocker tracking.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who created the task.

workspaceId.description: Shared team workspace identifier (e.g., ARBOR-TEAM-1) or PRIVATE.

taskKey.description: Short human-readable key such as ARB-101.

title.description: Display title of the task or milestone.

assigneeId.description: Document ID of the assigned team member.

assigneeName.description: Display name of the assigned junior or team member.

assigneeEmail.description: Gmail address of the assigned junior or team member.

assigneeRole.description: Role title of the assigned team member.

parentTaskId.description: Parent task ID in the progress tree (empty string for root nodes).

prerequisiteIds.description: Bounded list of upstream prerequisite task IDs that must finish before this task.

status.description: Current execution state of the task.

blockerReason.description: Explanation if the task is blocked or impacted by an upstream blocker.

reminderOffsetMinutes.description: Lead time in minutes before deadline for reminder notifications.

externalRef.description: External Jira, Linear, or Trello issue key.

BlockerAlert.title: BlockerAlert
BlockerAlert.description: Real-time blocker notification and escalation record for the executive dashboard.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who created the alert.

taskId.description: ID of the blocked root task.

taskKey.description: Human-readable key of the blocked task.

reportedByName.description: Name of the team member who flagged the blocker.

assigneeName.description: Name of the currently responsible owner.

impactedTaskKeys.description: Bounded list of downstream task keys impacted by this blocker.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the blocker alert.

resolutionNote.description: Resolution or escalation note added by a senior lead.

TeamMember.title: TeamMember
TeamMember.description: Team member profile in the workspace with Gmail identity for task assignment and workload distribution.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who registered the member.

displayName.description: Full display name of the team member.

email.description: Google/Gmail address of the team member.

isSenior.description: Whether the member has senior executive oversight role.

avatarColorHex.description: Hex color code for avatar badge.

IntegrationConfig.title: IntegrationConfig
IntegrationConfig.description: External project management and webhook integration configuration.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated workspace owner.

provider.description: External PM tool or webhook provider type.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint URL for webhook dispatches.

projectKey.description: External project prefix or board identifier.

autoDispatchBlockers.description: Whether blocker alerts automatically trigger a webhook payload.

autoSyncCalendar.description: Whether task deadlines sync with device calendar reminders.

lastSyncSummary.description: Status message of the most recent sync or dispatch.

TeamMessage.title: TeamMessage
TeamMessage.description: Real-time team chat message in the shared workspace with optional task and document references.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated message author.

senderRole.description: Role label of the sender (e.g., Senior Lead or Junior Engineer).

linkedTaskKey.description: Optional task key tagged in the message (e.g., ARB-102).

linkedDocId.description: Optional ID of a shared document attached to the message.

linkedDocTitle.description: Optional title of a shared document attached to the message.

TeamDocument.title: TeamDocument
TeamDocument.description: Shared team document, specification, Drive resource, or runbook in the workspace.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who shared the document.

externalUrl.description: Optional URL to Google Docs, Drive, Figma, or repository resource.

contentSummary.description: Inline document body, specification text, or imported file content.

linkedTaskKey.description: Optional task key associated with this document.

uploadedByName.description: Display name of the team member who shared the document.

uploadedByEmail.description: Gmail address of the team member who shared the document.

/tasks/{taskId}.description: Root collection of team tasks scoped by workspaceId, userId, and assigneeEmail.

/blockers/{blockerId}.description: Root collection of blocker alerts scoped by workspaceId and userId.

/members/{memberId}.description: Root collection of team members scoped by workspaceId and userId.

/integrations/{integrationId}.description: Root collection of external PM and webhook integrations scoped by workspaceId and userId.

/messages/{messageId}.description: Root collection of real-time team chat messages scoped by workspaceId and userId.

/documents/{documentId}.description: Root collection of shared team documents and specs scoped by workspaceId and userId.
